high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the platform Reels, featuring a large statue of Lord Shiva at the Murudeshwar Temple. The statue is depicted in a meditative pose, seated on a lotus flower with a tiger skin draped beneath it. Lord Shiva is adorned with traditional Hindu symbols, including a trident (trishul) held in his right hand, a conch shell (shankha) in his left hand, and a snake (naga) around his neck.
